title: German Shrimp Curry
description: A unique twist on traditional German cuisine, this shrimp curry brings the bold flavors of malaysian curry to the heart of Germany. This dish is perfect for a quick and delicious meal.
instructions: Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter to the skillet.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
Return the shrimp to the skillet and cook until coated in the curry sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.
